title: Mornington Racecourse Market
summary: Monthly craft market at Mornington Racecourse. 300+ stalls of hand-made, home-made and Australian-designed goods. Street food vendors, live music, animal farm and face painting for kids. Parking $5. Dogs not permitted (service dogs exempt).
recurrenceNote: Monthly – 2nd Sunday of month (year-round; occasionally 3rd Sunday due to racing events)
accessibilityNotes: Lower members car park and racecourse; gravel/bitumen/grass; undulating; use caution with prams
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Main Street Mornington; MPRG
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Mornington foreshore walk and Main Street dining
editorVerdict: 300 stalls under big Peninsula sky: if Red Hill is the marquee, Racecourse is the everyman version, and it runs all year.
editorNote:
Mornington Racecourse Market is the year-round answer to Red Hill (which goes quiet over winter). Second Sunday of the month, 300-plus stalls of hand-made and Australian-designed goods, street food, live music. Parking is $5 and dogs stay home (service dogs aside).

The move: arrive around 9:15am, do the food vendors before the queue, then the craft loop. The kids zone makes this a low-stress family Sunday. Heads up: occasional schedule shifts around race days, so check before driving from outside the Peninsula. The 10 May 2026 edition was cancelled for exactly this reason.
